corrected_answer: Assume the checkpoint, tokenizer, request trace and prompt/length distribution, decoding limits, serving stack, scheduler, hardware, drivers, power and thermal conditions are identical; change only weight precision. After warm-up and compilation, run repeated randomized interleaved paired baseline/treatment trials on disjoint calibration and held-out workloads. Predeclare scoring, thresholds, sample sizes and confidence-interval method. Report quality, safety, correctness, model and peak memory in GiB, TTFT and TPOT in ms/token, throughput in tokens/s, concurrency, utilization, errors, retries, timeouts, OOMs, kernel/fallback frequency, cleanup failures, and p50/p95/p99 with units. Record prompt mix, batching, cache warm-up, thermal state, software versions and power; stratify by input/output length and load. Use only authorized data and systems, redact sensitive traces, bound the canary, retain the baseline, stop on quality, safety, correctness, error-rate, latency, OOM or cost regressions, and roll back atomically.
